question: Should Hermit adopt the pinned canonical OpenClaw pull request template as its repository contribution policy?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically clean, but adopting contributor instructions is a repository-governance choice that automated review cannot authorize for a member-authored PR.

options.title: Adopt the canonical template
options.body: Approve and merge the current head so Hermit uses the shared OpenClaw problem, rationale, impact, and evidence structure.

options.title: Keep repository-local policy
options.body: Close or revise the PR if Hermit intentionally needs different contribution instructions or no pull request template.

recommendation.title: Adopt the canonical template
recommendation.body: Approve and merge the current head so Hermit uses the shared OpenClaw problem, rationale, impact, and evidence structure.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the organization member coordinating the pinned cross-repository policy synchronization and can provide the clearest intent context.
